title: Address rising unemployment in Karnali
description: Unemployment rate in Karnali municipalities exceeds 22%, well above national average.
suggested_action: Launch targeted skills & employment program; expand jobseeker registration.

title: Disability certificate backlog in Madhesh
description: Over 1,200 disability ID applications pending hospital certification.
suggested_action: Deploy mobile assessment camps with district hospitals.

title: Remittance dependency in Gandaki
description: Over 35% of households depend on foreign remittance; high economic risk.
suggested_action: Promote returnee reintegration & local enterprise grants.

title: School dropout spike in Lumbini
description: Secondary dropout rate increased 8% year on year.
suggested_action: Expand scholarship coverage; targeted retention program.

title: Water & sanitation gap in Sudurpashchim
description: 30% of households lack piped water access.
suggested_action: Prioritise rural water supply infrastructure budget.

title: Senior citizen allowance coverage in Bagmati
description: Eligible seniors not enrolled estimated at 4,500.
suggested_action: Automated eligibility detection rollout; door-to-door enrollment.

title: Monsoon disaster preparedness — Koshi
description: High-risk wards identified for landslide/flooding this monsoon.
suggested_action: Pre-position relief; update vulnerable household registry.
